servicePages.content:
Orthopedic is a medical specialty focused on diagnosis, treatment, prevention and rehabilitation of injuries, diseases and congenital disorders affecting the body's musculoskeletal system. Restoring independence, dignity and self-worth is our core objective through;
1. Treatment therapy which involves use of prescribed medication by the resident's physician.

2. Nursing care. 
• Drug administration 
• Wound care 
• Close clinical monitoring and observations for infections 
• Personal care
• Management of pain and swellings
• Psychological and emotional support 
• Safety supervision 
• Physiotherapy 
• Mobility rehabilitation 

Recovery practices
• Protein rich diet for tissue repair 
• Short, frequent walks to restore mobility 
• Increase fluid intake

Safety precautions 
• Refrain from heavy lifting, driving or overexating factivities.
• Do not soak incision site into water until cleared by the physician.
• Prevent falls

Why CAFOLA?
1. Accommodation. Premium, convenient and comfortable environment with privacy.
2. Safety. Reduced exposure to infection risks in hospital environments (nosocomial infections)
3. Accelerated recovery. Residents recover and restore  faster of baseline functions in a homelike setting.
4. Access to basic recovery support aids or devices like walking frames, compression socks, braces elbow crutches and others.

Start care with CAFOLA today.

servicePages.title: Stroke Recovery & Rehabilitation
servicePages.description: We provide one-on-one professional nursing care and personalized rehabilitation plan for residents recovering from stroke.
servicePages.content:
Stroke is a medical emergency that occur when blood flow to the brain is blocked or a vessel bursts. When stroke affect your loved one, seek  immediate hospital intervention. 

Stroke recovery is a gradual process taking weeks, months or more to clear. 

Long-term effects 
• Loss of consciousness 
• Potential permanent weakness 
• Paralysis and numbness
• Memory and cognitive deterioration 
• Speech difficulties 
• Emotional changes.

However, research suggests that stroke can be prevented by;
• Blood pressure control and management 
• Cholesterol management 
• Smoking cessation 

When you or your loved one get affected, it needs 

1. Hospital intervention 
• Medication 
• Surgical procedures.

2. A recovery center.
CAFOLA ensures continuity of care post hospital acute treatment and management, provide long-term plan and support with focus on preventing further complications, fostering independence and providing structured rehabilitation, hence reducing hospital overstay.

Our core care include;
• Medication administration (prescribed by your physician)
• Memory and cognitive stimulation 
• Physiotherapy to improve activity and cardio fitness.
• Healthy diets
• Blood pressure management and control 
• Pain assessment and management (for residents who cannot self report 
• Speech therapy 
• Occupational rehabilitation 
• Post-stroke depression management 
• Infection prevention and control 
• Pneumatic compression for DVT prevention 
• Mobility training and aid
• High hygiene standards 
• GP visits.

We work with your physician / hospital and our multidisciplinary team to draw and execute a long-term care plan for your loved one. 

Reach out to us today.

Post-operative period is a vital phase that starts after completion of surgical procedure, then the client is transferred to the Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) or the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). This phase ensure high-level close monitoring. 

When client stabilize, is progressed to phase II - the Medical -Surgical Unit (surgical ward) for further management and full stabilization. 

In phase III, client transition to recovery center or extended care environment where CAFOLA handle the final phase of post-operative care to ensure complete recovery.

We focus greatly on;
• Vital signs monitoring 
• Medication management and administration 
• DVT prevention 
• Fluid balance 
• Pain assessment and management with prescribed analgesics by your physician 
• Wound and incision care
• Infection prevention 
• Emotional support to client and family.

We plan care with your physician / hospital and family.

Reach to us to start care today.

servicePages.content:
Dementia is not a normal part of aging. If you or your loved one are experiencing persistent memory issues or cognitive changes, it is essential to consult a healthcare provider for a proper evaluation.

Dementia progresses through three stages;
1. Early stage. Symptoms are noticable the individual remains mostly independent.
2. Middle stage. Symptoms become more pronounced and the person requires increased support with daily life activities (DLA).
3. Late stage. The individual becomes heavily reliant on support for basic DLA and personal care. 

Core symptoms 
• Memory loss; person struggles to remember events or previous conversations 
• Communication; person experiences trouble finding the right words or expressing thoughts clearly (compared to previous times).
• Visual perception; issues with depth perception or navigating familiar environments.
• Thinking and reasoning; finds difficult in concentrating, planning or making decisions.
• Behavior and personality changes. 

CAFOLA is with you in handling;
• Symptom management 
• Prescription medication administration.
• Behavioral and mental care
• Vascular care
servicePages.description: Helping loved ones with cognitive challenges and symptoms characterized by decline in mental ability is not just easy, it knowledge and passion.
servicePages.title: Dementia Care

servicePages.content:
Diabetes is a long-term, noncommunicable health challenge we've got to learn how to live with. The overall focus is to have a stabilized blood glucose levels. Both high and low blood glucose in diabetes can lead to acute and chronic complications. That's why care for diabetic individuals is vital and continuous. 

CAFOLA intervention in diabetes.
We are designed to work with families and individuals living with diabetes in;
• Blood sugar/glucose monitoring. Aimed at analysing to prevent severe hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
• Diabetic foot care. Daily assessment for redness, swelling or open sores. 
• Wound management. Taking curative care for ulcers or pressure injuries and infection monitoring.
• Nutrition. With the recommendations of the physician and nutritionist, we provide diabetes friendly diet. 

Talk to us to start care now.
servicePages.description: Round the clock monitoring and obsering trend of our resident's blood glucose levels.

Physiotherapy
servicePages.description: Helping loved ones regain full strength, function, movement and performance during the recovery journey following a debilitating illness.
servicePages.content:
Physiotherapy uses physical techniques to help treat medical conditions and injuries.
Physiotherapists can diagnose and manage a broad range of medical conditions. These conditions may affect your;
• bones
• muscles
• nerves
• lungs
• and other parts and systems of the body.
This can be done through;
• massage 
• heat treatment
• joint manipulation 
• muscle stretch up 
• exercises 
• and others.

You have got a reason to lay your trust on our multidisciplinary team.

Speech therapy is a clinical approach to diagnose and manage communication and swallowing disorders. Our speech-language pathologists (SLPs) guide individuals through specialized exercises and techniques to improve speaking ability, language comprehension and other aspects of communication.
servicePages.description: Specialized treatment to improve ability to communicate, process language and safely swallow in children with developmental concerns and adults recovering from illness.
servicePages.title: Speech therapy
Psychotherapy
servicePages.content:
Psychotherapy / talk therapy refers to a variety of treatments that aim to help a person identify and change troubling emotions, thoughts, and behaviors. Most psychotherapy takes place one-on-one with our professional. 

Let us know your need.
servicePages.description: Standing with you to identify and modify troubling thoughts, emotions and behaviors of your loved one.

servicePages.title: Occupational therapy
servicePages.content: Our therapists will design and customize interventions to help you meet your goals and safely participate in your daily routine. Occupational therapy does not necessarily mean the ability to do your job. However, some people use occupational therapy to help them get back to their work after an injury. Occupation is a general term used to mean any of the daily tasks you do.
servicePages.description: Improving motor skills, cognitive functioning and addressing effective ways to perform tasks bypassing physical limitations for better lifestyle.
Emotional and social support with physical care.
servicePages.content:
There's no gift you can give to your family member than ensuring premium living with emotional, social and physical support when needed most. It defines true love. We are proud to join families in the support of their loved ones. We welcome you to;

1. CAFOLA Residence. Where we provide special homely environment with privacy. Comes with bedroom, bathroom, living room and other amenities. 

2. CAFOLA Family. This is when families bind. We think, plan and work together in support of the resident. We ensure;
• Meal planning & preparation 
• Mental and emotional support 
• Safety supervision 
• Light exercise / physiotherapy 
• Grooming and hygiene 
• Laundry 
• Social activities 
• Taking walks

3. CAFOLA Care. Life is very fragile, so we are always awake.
• Blood pressure monitoring 
• Blood glucose monitoring 
• Medication management
• Medical appointments management.
servicePages.title: Experience

storyParagraphs: Home is where routines feel familiar and life feels grounded. CAFOLA was built to protect that feeling for older adults and families navigating change.
Our mission is simple: empower people to age, recover, and live confidently in the place they know best.
Through expert caregivers, family coaching, and thoughtful planning, we help make complex care decisions more manageable.
caregiversHeading: A Care Team Families Can Trust
caregiversCopy: CAFOLA caregivers are selected for compassion, trained for excellence, and matched to each client's needs.
If you're driven by purpose and want a meaningful career in home care, we'd love to meet you.

aboutUs.headline: CAFOLA is a residential recovery center, providing premium living with continuity of professional nursing care to individuals who no longer need hospital admission.
aboutUs.staffDescription: Our staff are not only qualified but are also passionate, dependable and trustworthy individuals who respect privacy, personal dignity and maintain confidentiality with professionalism. In the strive to improve comfort, we pair our residents with the most fit staff to serve the best. Do you need a Swahili, Hindi, Chinese, Arabic or Tigrinya speaker? Talk to us.
aboutUs.description: With over 10 years of experience providing nursing care services, CAFOLA now operates residential recovery centers providing premium living, professional 24/7 nursing support, ensuring safety, comfort and privacy for residents.
aboutUs.cultureAndFamily: As our principal has always been, "maintaining culture and family ties", we design your routines around your choices so you can stay connected to the people and places you love. Our resident's choice to have a loved one or member of the family to stay-in is welcome.
aboutUs.scopeOfService: Whether you or your loved one need basic or skilled, short or long-term care, CAFOLA is meant for you. We personalize every care and support plan in collaboration with your physician and hospital to help you live the life you deserve.
aboutUs.experience: From 2015, CAFOLA has provided bedside and home nursing care services to hundreds of families and individuals. We've worked with national and international institutions in provision of nursing care to their members.
